thread:
julia-cs: Customer reported being charged twice after a flaky connection. They saw a partial stream, reconnected, and got the full message again — billed twice.
kevin: can you paste the minimal client logs and the resume token they used (please scrub PII)?
julia-cs: pasted below (scrubbed):
```
[2026-09-03T09:14:02Z] connect session=sess-42 token=rt_xyz123
[2026-09-03T09:14:15Z] sse: data: {\"type\":\"chunk\",\"seq\":1}
[2026-09-03T09:14:16Z] network drop
[2026-09-03T09:14:17Z] reconnect session=sess-42 token=rt_xyz123 last_ack=0
[2026-09-03T09:14:18Z] gateway: resume lookup -> MISS
[2026-09-03T09:14:19Z] runtime: new generation g-20260903-1
[2026-09-03T09:14:21Z] generation complete g-20260903-1
```
julia-cs: Customer insists they reused the same resume token.
tyler: resume MISS suggests either the resume map expired or the gateway looked up the wrong key. last_ack=0 is suspicious — means client didn't confirm receipt to the server.
manda: customer offered to run a repro script. gave them a curl-based test.
julia-cs: repro steps I gave them:
```
# start stream and capture first chunk
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
# kill connection after seeing first chunk
# reconnect immediately using same resume token and last_ack=0
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?resume_token=rt_xyz123&last_ack=0\"
```
kevin: checklist for infra: 1) confirm resume TTL in gateway cache, 2) check whether resume keys are evicted on high mem pressure, 3) audit last_ack interpretation (0 vs missing).
tyler: another possible race: gateway issues resume lookup concurrently while runtime finalizes; if lookup returns false negative we spin up a new generation and create a duplicate. We should log resume_lookup_latency and runtime_state.
billing-bot: @julia-cs account ACC-789 flagged — two charges detected for the same logical turn, queued for manual review :warning:
manda: I've paused auto-billing for the account and offered provisional credit pending investigation. Customer wants a clear root-cause or credit.
kevin: short-term mitigation we can recommend to the customer: include an idempotency-key per logical user-turn. Server can dedupe new-gen if idempotency-key matches an in-flight or recent generation. Also suggest the client persist and forward last_ack precisely as emitted by the SDK.
tyler: longer-term work: implement a 60s sticky-lease on resume entries in the gateway. If reconnect happens within the lease, route to same in-flight generation. Also add server-side de-dupe window: if a new gen starts within N seconds of an existing in-flight gen for the same session/resume key, don't finalize billing until we reconcile.
julia-cs: customer asked why last_ack could be 0 if they saw a chunk on their UI.
kevin: possible: some clients render chunks immediately but only ACK at message boundaries. If the SDK defers ACKs, UI could display content but the server never received an ack. Need to check SDK flush/ack policy. I'll open an SDK ticket.
manda: please capture the SDK version from the customer. I've asked finance for a provisional credit hold while we debug.
kevin: repro plan for eng teams:
1) run gateway + runtime locally with controllable delays.
2) stream, deliver first SSE chunk, then drop connection.
3) reconnect within different windows (1s, 3s, 30s) using same resume token with last_ack=0 or omitted.
4) capture gateway logs (resume_lookup_result, resume_lookup_ms), runtime state, and billing events.
5) validate sticky-lease patch pins reconnects within 60s to same generation.
tyler: labeling: priority=high, area=streaming,retry,idempotency. assign to eng-runtime + gateway.
kevin: created ENG-6001 and attached scrubbed logs + repro harness.
support-bot: Ticket ENG-6001 created by kevin. SLA: 48h. https://tickets.redwood.ai/ENG-6001
manda: customer agreed to provisional credit if duplicate billing confirmed. I'll update them within 24h.
julia-cs: thanks — adding customer timeline and SDK version to ENG-6001. please keep this thread in the loop.
kevin: quick mitigation we can deploy fast: treat missing resume_lookup as transient and hold billing for 5s to see if runtime finalizes; if runtime completes with same session token match, reconcile without charging duplicate. This is a temporary safety net.
tyler: also pushing for better observability: expose resume_cache_size and evictions metric, and a per-request resume_lookup_ms field in logs.
manda: finance will provision temporary credit line; I'll follow up.
kevin: opening SDK issue: SDK-222 add explicit last_ack flush on first chunk and document resume integration idioms.
julia-cs: closing loop with customer: told them we're investigating, offered provisional credit, and will share repro steps if they want to try again after SDK change.
manda: keep me posted with ETA and any bill adjustments so I can update account teams.
kevin: will post gateway debug snippet to ENG-6001 shortly. initial hypothesis: resume TTL too short + ambiguous last_ack semantics + race during runtime finalization.
tyler: noted. adding a 3s server-side de-dupe grace window while we ship sticky-lease.
kevin: updating ENG-6001 now.
manda: thanks everyone.
